title: MinMax
text: Output minimum or maximum input value, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Function} sets the minimum, {Number of input ports}, {Apply over} sets how to apply function along specified dimensions All, {Dimension} sets the dimension along which to apply, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Require all inputs to have the same data type} sets the inputs must have the same data type, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_N
ports.summary: N th input signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Minimum or maximum values of inputs scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Function
params.values: Specify minimum or maximum min (default) | max

params.values: Specify number of input ports 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Apply over
params.values: How to apply function along specified dimensions All dimensions (default) | Specified dimension

params.values: Specify the dimension along which to apply function 1 (default) | positive integer |... | N

params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
